title: Marina Specht Blum (ex-CEO McCann Worldgroup, FORBES Top 100) picks Incorruptible for her summer reading list
summary: Marina Specht Blum — board member, senior advisor, former CEO and Chair of McCann Worldgroup, and one of FORBES' Top 100 Most Influential Women — chooses Incorruptible as one of five books for her 2026 summer reading list, framed around leadership and how companies don't degrade because bad managers arrive but because systems and incentives make good decisions harder over time.
blockquote: Muchos leímos a Eric Ries en su superhit The Lean Startup. Ahora trata de una idea a la que yo le he dado muchas vueltas: las empresas no suelen deteriorarse porque aparezcan malos directivos, sino porque terminan construyendo sistemas e incentivos que hacen cada vez más difícil tomar buenas decisiones.
attribution_title: Board Member & Senior Advisor; former CEO & Chair, McCann Worldgroup; FORBES Top 100 Most Influential Women
